name: @aegis-sarl/node
description: Aegis in-app firewall for Node. Inspects requests, reports what it saw, and blocks only when told to.

scripts.build: bun build ./index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm && tsc index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --types node --outDir dist
